# QRCodeOptions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Options for [`QRCode`](qr-code.md).

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
type QRCodeOptions = ElementOptions & Partial<Omit<Pick<QRCode, (typeof QR_CODE_OWN_OPTION_KEYS)[number]>, 'foregroundColor' | 'backgroundColor' | 'errorCorrection' | 'size'>> & {
    /** Symbol size. Accepts a length: `100`, `'3cm'`, or `{ value, unit }`. */
    size?: LengthInput;
    /** Module colour. Accepts a palette token or hex. */
    foregroundColor?: ColorInput;
    /** Quiet-zone colour. Accepts a palette token or hex. */
    backgroundColor?: ColorInput;
    /** Error-correction level. Accepts `'low' | 'medium' | 'quartile' | 'high'`. */
    errorCorrection?: QrEccInput;
}
```

### `altText`

```typescript
altText?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

Alternate text description for accessibility (e.g. "QR code to https://example.com"). Populates the `/Alt` entry on the structure element when the document opts into PDF/UA-1.

### `backgroundColor`

```typescript
backgroundColor?: ColorInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Quiet-zone colour. Accepts a palette token or hex.

### `breakAllowed`

```typescript
breakAllowed?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

Whether this element can be split across page boundaries. When false, the element is treated as atomic and will be moved to a new page rather than split. If it doesn't fit on a fresh page either, it renders anyway. Default is true.

### `captureName`

```typescript
captureName?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

Optional author-supplied name/key surfaced in the layout snapshot. Unset by default; a future capture API can populate it.

### `contentDirection`

```typescript
contentDirection?: ContentDirectionInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Inline progression and paragraph base direction; omitted inherits.

### `data`

```typescript
data?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

The data/text to encode in the QR Code.

### `drawBackground`

```typescript
drawBackground?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

Whether to draw the background color. If false, the QR code will be transparent.

### `errorCorrection`

```typescript
errorCorrection?: QrEccInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Error-correction level. Accepts `'low' | 'medium' | 'quartile' | 'high'`.

### `foregroundColor`

```typescript
foregroundColor?: ColorInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Module colour. Accepts a palette token or hex.

### `isDecorative`

```typescript
isDecorative?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

When `true`, the QR code is purely decorative and is tagged as `/Artifact` with no alt-text warning.

### `keepWithNext`

```typescript
keepWithNext?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

Keeps this element with the start of its next sibling in vertical flow.

### `margin`

```typescript
margin?: ThicknessInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Margin around this element. Accepts `12`, `[h, v]`, `[l, t, r, b]` or `{ bottom: 12 }`; omitted sides are zero.

### `quietZone`

```typescript
quietZone?: number | undefined
```

*optional*

Number of quiet-zone modules around the QR code. The spec recommends 4. Set to 0 to disable.

### `size`

```typescript
size?: LengthInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Symbol size. Accepts a length: `100`, `'3cm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.
